entities.summary: Michele Mari is an Italian novelist, short story writer, academic critic and poet, considered one of Italy's most esteemed and original living authors. The son of a Milanese industrial designer and artist, Enzo Mari, Mari teaches Italian literature at the Università Statale di Milano; he is considered one of the leading experts of 18th century Italian literature. English translations of his work have won the O. Henry Prize, two PEN Translates Awards, and the 2025 PEN Translation Prize.
